summary: CalcPro disguise calculator screen tested. All core flows pass: calculator appears on launch, arithmetic works, AC clears, wrong PIN stays locked, correct PIN (5765=) unlocks the real app. Real app (consent/privacy screen) accessible after unlock.

issues: Dimensions.get('window') called at module-level (line 31 in CalcPro.tsx) captures browser width at import time (~1920px in desktop preview). On web preview at 375px viewport, buttons render at ~465px wide (off-screen). On native mobile build this is fine since Dimensions reflects actual device screen. No fix needed for native builds.

action_items: Optional: Move Dimensions.get('window') inside the component or use useWindowDimensions hook to make CalcPro responsive on web. Not critical for native builds.
critical_code_review_comments: CalcPro.tsx line 31: `const { width: SCREEN_W, height: SCREEN_H } = Dimensions.get('window')` is a module-level constant. On web it captures the window size at bundle evaluation time (typically 1920px in desktop preview), making buttons extremely wide. On native this is fine. Consider using useWindowDimensions hook inside the component if web support is needed.
